Dear Ms. Caldwell:
Enclosed are Proposed Orders reflecting today’s rulings on defendants’ demurrer to the fifth
and ninth causes of action in your second amended complaint and defendants’ motion to
strike portions of your second amended complaint. If these meet with your approval, please
sign them, approving them as to form, and return them to my office. I will then submit them
to the court and thereafter serve you with the respective notices of entry of order as soon as I
have them.
If we do not receive your endorsement of these proposed orders by October 28, 2002, we will
send them, as they are, to Judge Robertson.
Very truly yours,
om Prountzos
